newsitem.title: UK: EU grants free mkt barley,raises Spain maize quota.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free mkt barley,raises Spain maize quota.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday granted the following licences to export free market grain to non-EU countries, member-country officials said.
Bids for open market rye, oats for Switzerland and Liechtenstein and Finnish intervention barley were rejected, they said.
A European grain official said the EU made no change to its wheat export tax at Thursday's weekly tender.
The French cereals office ONIC said the EU raised the allocation for preferential maize imports to Spain by 300,000 tonnes.
Bidding for tariff reductions under the previous quota of 500,000 tonnes began on Thursday but the EU's cereals management committee rejected all bids, officials said.

Under a trade agreement with the United States, traders can bid for reductions in import tariffs up to a set quantity of maize available at a tender. The preferential imports are designed to compensate U.S. farmers for trade losses caused by Spain's accession to the EU in 1986.
